notes.title: Ninja Midori is now on Linux + Mac OS
notes.content:
Ninja Midori is now on Linux + Mac OS

So now any Linux + Steam OS or MAC OS users can play the game on that platform :).

notes.title: Ninja Midori Update #3
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32842561/e37d78ac6e52c23355ed746b9a5da6d2389e9227.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32842561/404d840a794b4a1ce48ec29898fbf6d15f8366e3.png[/img][/url]
I have made some changes to the game to make it more smooth.

[list]
[*]  An options menu has been added, where you can now set the games resolution and decide what graphics quality you would like to play the game in.
[*] Which should make the game run more smoothly
[*]  I have made it so that music loops when you die, so if you die in a level it doesn't restart the entire song again.
[*]  I decided to get some new cover art
[*] You can now mute audio in the game
[*] Fixed the error where ogres could kill you in one hit
[*] Got rid of the flickering black and white line which sometimes occurred
[*] Minor changes have been made to some levels
[/list]

notes.title: Boss Update
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32842561/f9fdefa57a8e891e7c64506f6994558453106356.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32842561/e53976594043fa610ba7fcbf2271a4af1c78da73.jpg[/img][/url]

Ninja Midori has received a boss updaate

[list]
[*] Two new bosses have been added they can be found at the end of level 5 
and Level 10 and some other minor fixes have been made
[*] The sword Ninja Midori was holding has been removed as it was confusing

notes.title: Update Time
notes.content:
A few updates have been made to the game

Updates

[list]
[*] Sounds will not overlap when you finish the level
[*] Hearts have been added to each level allowing you to gain hearts in a level if you lost them
[*] Shurikens have been added to levels allowing you to collect more Shurikens in a level

notes.title: Multiplayer Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32842561/a4a0b86a16e0e8912107d726c89e16116970a73f.png[/img]

Check out the Co-op trailer here : https://youtu.be/agOA01x1La8

Ninja Midori has gotten an big update I am happy to announce multiplayer to Ninja Midori.
This game mode will allow you and one other person your friend, partner or sibling to play the game with. 
One person will be playing as Ninja Midori the green Ninja and another person will play as Ninja Ao, Ninja Midori's brother. 
Will you be able to rescue the princess with some added extra help, we will find out?

For Co-op you need to have two game controllers.

notes.title: Ninja Midori gets steam achivements
notes.content:
Good news everyone, Ninja Midori has gotten steam achievements I have added 10 steam achievements the question is can complete them all.

If you have the game go back and see if you can beat the achievements.
If you don't have the game see if you can beat the challenge of getting all the achievements :)

Also patches have also been added to make the game smoother  


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32842561/4dc48a4329e398324fff707340593918a203880a.png[/img]
